data.name: Mehulraj
data.gender_notes: Mehulraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mehulraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'mehul' (ruler) and 'raj' (king). It is believed to be the name of a mythological king or ruler. The name Mehulraj carries the meaning “Ruler of the Mehul” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mehulraj usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the mehul and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mehulraj is a powerful and spiritual name that represents enlightenment and royalty. It is a name that inspires confidence and respect, and is often given to children who are expected to lead and rule in the future.
data.etymology: Mehulraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Mehul.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehulraj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
